name: v2-c12-suites-inelegiveis
input: Ao descartar as suítes inelegíveis antes do mutation testing, por que a análise passa a refletir exclusivamente a ability of tests to detect faults, e por que a Mutant Generation foi restrita ao target method de cada classe?
input_en: When ineligible suites are discarded before mutation testing, why does the analysis reflect exclusively the ability of tests to detect faults, and why was mutant generation restricted to the target method of each class?
expected_output: A análise reflete exclusivamente a capacidade de detecção de falhas porque os mutantes foram restritos ao método-alvo, evitando distorções causadas por métodos fora do escopo definido para os testes.
context: Ineligible suites were discarded and did not proceed to the mutation testing stage. This filter ensures that the analysis reflects exclusively the ability of tests to detect faults, rather than structural or logical issues of the generated suites.

Mutant generation was restricted to the target method of each class by configuring the <excludedMethods> parameter via pom.xml, excluding all other methods from the mutation scope. This decision avoids distortions in the analyses, since the LLMs were instructed to generate tests only for the target method; mutants generated in other methods would inevitably remain uncovered, surviving not due to limitations of the test suites but because they lie outside the defined test scope.

name: v2-c15-p-use-c-use
input: Quando uma referencia a uma variavel e classificada como p-use em vez de c-use, e a que elemento do grafo de fluxo de controle cada uma se associa?
input_en: When is a reference to a variable classified as a p-use rather than a c-use, and which element of the control flow graph is each one associated with?
expected_output: Quando a referência influencia o fluxo de controle do programa — como em condições de estruturas de decisão ou de repetição — ela é um p-use, associado às arestas do grafo de fluxo de controle. Os c-uses, por sua vez, estão associados ao resultado de uma computação e aos nós do CFG.
context: computational uses (c-use), references to variables that directly affect the outcome of a computation, associated with nodes of the Control Flow Graph (CFG); and predicate uses (p-use), references that influence the program’s control flow, such as conditions in decision or loop structures, associated with transitions between graph nodes [11].
